title: Crack spreading along the South Koel embankment near Basia
body_original: मेरा नाम सुनीता उरांव है, मैं गुमला ज़िला के बसिया से बोल रही हूँ। हमारे टोला के बगल में कोयल नदी का मिट्टी का बांध है, उसमें पुलिया के पास दरार आ गई है। पिछले बरसात में एक हाथ की थी, अब पूरा हाथ अंदर चला जाता है और गांव की तरफ बढ़ रही है। जुलाई में पानी चढ़ा तो चालीस घर और स्कूल डूब जाएंगे। मुखिया को दो बार बताया, कोई देखने नहीं आया।
body_en: My name is Sunita Oraon, I am speaking from Basia in Gumla district. Next to our tola there is a mud embankment on the Koel river, and a crack has opened in it near the culvert. Last monsoon it was one hand wide; now my whole arm goes inside and it is growing towards the village side. If the water rises in July, forty houses and the school will go under. We told the mukhiya twice, nobody has come to look.

title: कोयल नदी के बांध में दरार बढ़ रही है
body_original: बसिया के पास कोयल नदी का जो मिट्टी का बांध है, उसमें पुलिया के पास बड़ी दरार आ गई है। पिछले बरसात के बाद से दरार हर महीने लंबी होती जा रही है। बारिश में पानी अगर इस दरार से घुसा तो पूरा टोला डूब जाएगा। हम लोग पत्थर डाल रहे हैं पर काम नहीं हो रहा।

title: Koel river bund near Basia culvert is splitting, water seeps in rains
body_original: I am the ASHA worker for this panchayat. The river bund on the Koel near the Basia culvert is splitting open. In the last rain I saw muddy water seeping from the lower side of the crack even though the river was not full. If this bund goes, the lower tola with mostly Oraon families and the anganwadi will be under water. Please send someone who understands bunds, not just a JCB.

title: सारे कुएं सूख गए, औरतें तीन किलोमीटर से पानी ला रही हैं
body_original: भंडरिया प्रखंड के हमारे गांव में मार्च से ही सारे कुएं और दो चापाकल सूख जाते हैं। औरतें और बच्चियां सुबह चार बजे उठकर तीन किलोमीटर दूर नाले से पानी लाती हैं। हर साल यही हाल है, पर इस साल जनवरी से ही कुआं खाली है। टैंकर कभी-कभी आता है। कोई ऐसा उपाय बताइए जिससे गांव का पानी गांव में रुके।

title: चांडिल डैम का पानी हर बरसात में गांव में घुस आता है
body_original: हम चांडिल डैम के किनारे बसे विस्थापित गांव के हैं। जब डैम का गेट खुलता है या पानी पीछे चढ़ता है तो हर साल अगस्त में हमारे खेत और घर के आंगन तक पानी आ जाता है। हमें कोई पहले से खबर नहीं देता, रात में पानी आता है। बुज़ुर्ग और बच्चे कैसे निकलें? कम से कम एक दिन पहले बताने का कोई तरीका होना चाहिए।

title: घर की दीवारों में दरार और ज़मीन से धुआँ निकल रहा है
body_original: झरिया में हमारा घर बीसीसीएल की पुरानी खदान के ऊपर है। पिछले साल से दीवारों में दरार आ रही है और आंगन में एक जगह से गर्म धुआँ निकलता है, रात में ज़मीन गर्म रहती है। पुनर्वास की लिस्ट में हमारा नाम कब आएगा पता नहीं। इस बीच हम कैसे जानें कि घर कब गिर सकता है? कोई नापने का तरीका हो तो बताइए।

title: Abandoned open cast pits near Mandu fill with water, ground sinks around them
body_original: Around Kuju and Mandu there are old CCL open cast pits that were never filled back. They fill with water in monsoon and two boys drowned last year. On the pit edge the ground is sinking and a footpath collapsed. People still graze cattle there and cut grass. We want to know which parts are unsafe and how to fence or fill them, the company says it is not their pit anymore.

title: Red dust from iron ore trucks settles on paddy and the Koina river runs red
body_original: I teach at the middle school in Noamundi. The ore trucks run day and night on the road through our village and red dust covers the paddy, the leaves, the water in the tank. After rain the Koina river runs red for days and cattle refuse to drink. Children in my class cough all winter. We are not against the mine, we want to know how bad the dust is and what can be planted or built to stop it reaching the fields.

title: Hand pump water in our tola makes children's teeth brown and old people's knees bend
body_original: In Chhatarpur block our tola has three hand pumps and every one of them gives water that leaves white crust on the pot. Children of eight and ten have brown spotted teeth and my father cannot straighten his legs any more. Health camp said it is fluoride and to drink another water, but there is no other water within two kilometres. Tell us which hand pump is least bad, or how to remove it at home.

title: पलामू में तीन साल से खरीफ की धान सूख रही है, मज़दूरी के लिए लोग बाहर जा रहे हैं
body_original: पांकी के हमारे गांव में टांड़ ज़मीन ज़्यादा है। तीन साल से जुलाई में बारिश देर से आती है और सितंबर में रुक जाती है, धान की बाली आते-आते सूख जाती है। आधे घरों के जवान लड़के बाहर ईंट भट्ठे पर चले गए। कोई ऐसी खेती या बीज बताइए जो इस पानी में हो जाए, या पानी रोकने का ऐसा तरीका जो हम खुद बना सकें।

title: मनरेगा साइट पर दोपहर में मज़दूर बेहोश हो रहे हैं
body_original: मेदिनीनगर के आसपास अप्रैल-मई में दोपहर में तालाब खुदाई का काम चलता है। इस साल दो मज़दूर काम करते-करते गिर गए, एक की मौत सदर अस्पताल में हो गई। साइट पर न छाया है न ओआरएस। गर्मी कब जानलेवा होगी, यह पहले से कैसे पता चले और काम का समय कैसे बदले, यह कोई तय करे।

title: Hill spring above our Paharia hamlet dries by April and loose motions start in every house
body_original: We are Sauria Paharia living on the hill in Sunderpahari. Our only water is a spring below the village. From April it is a trickle and we dig in the sand for water. Every year in May-June children get loose motions and two or three die before they reach the road, which is nine kilometres of walking. The PHE tank on the hill has never had water. We need a way to keep the spring alive and to know early when the sickness is starting.

title: Ale ato re dak' banuk'a — kuĩ rohor ena
body_original: Ale ato re dak' banuk'a. Kuĩ do rohor ena, chapakol ho dak' bang oḍok'a. Maejiu ko sangin khon dak' ko agu eda, Kathikund hor re. Dhiri buru latar re dak' menak'a mente ko men eda, menkhan okoe ho bang ñam let'a. (हमारे गांव में पानी नहीं है, कुआं सूख गया, चापाकल से भी पानी नहीं निकलता। औरतें काठीकुंड सड़क तक दूर से पानी ला रही हैं। लोग कहते हैं पहाड़ के नीचे पानी है पर किसी को मिला नहीं।)

title: Netarhat ghat road slips every monsoon and cuts off the plateau villages
body_original: Between Mahuadanr and Netarhat the ghat road slides at the same three bends every July. Last year it was closed for eleven days, a woman in labour had to be carried down on a cot. The PWD puts back the mud and it goes again. Someone should study why those three bends slide and how to hold them, and we need a way to know the night before it will go.

title: Fires in the sal forest near Garu every March burn our mahua and reach the village edge
body_original: We live on the edge of the tiger reserve forest near Garu. Every March-April fire comes through the sal forest, mostly started for mahua collection or by passers-by. Our mahua trees, tendu and the lac on kusum get burnt, and twice the fire reached the cattle shed. Forest guard says he has no people. We want to know where the fire will come from and a way to stop it before it reaches us, not after.

title: Children cross the swollen river to school on a bamboo raft because there is no bridge
body_original: In Bano block our village is on the far side of a river from the high school and the health sub-centre. From July to September the water is chest deep and children cross on a bamboo raft or do not go. Two years ago a boy was swept away. We have asked for a bridge for ten years. Till a bridge comes, is there a safer crossing we can build ourselves, and how do we know the day the river is too high?

title: The Ganga is eating our village at Rajmahal, twelve houses gone in two years
body_original: Our village on the Ganga bank near Rajmahal is being cut away. In two years twelve houses and the primary school ground have fallen into the river. Every monsoon the bank falls in pieces at night and we hear it. The sandbags the department put last year were gone in a month. We do not know which houses go next. We want to know where the river will cut and something that actually holds the bank.

title: Harmu river overflows into the colony every big rain, drains flow backwards
body_original: I live in Harmu Housing Colony in Ranchi. Whenever it rains hard for a few hours the Harmu river comes over the wall and the drains flow backwards into our lanes and ground floors. This happened four times last monsoon. The river was made narrow and cemented and now it has nowhere to go. We want to understand where the water comes from and where it should go, so the corporation stops guessing.

title: Primary school below the Konar canal floods and closes every August
body_original: The government primary school of our village in Gomia is below the Konar canal. Every August water from the canal overflow and the field above comes into the classrooms and the school closes for two to three weeks. Books and midday meal stock get spoiled. Children of class one and two stop coming after that and some do not come back. Either the water has to be sent somewhere else or the school has to be lifted.

title: Lac on our kusum trees is failing because the rains have gone wrong
body_original: In Murhu our families have kept lac on kusum and ber trees for generations. For three years the brood dies in the rains, sometimes from too much rain in September, sometimes because winter came too late. Half the families have stopped and gone to Ranchi for daily wage. The price is fine, it is the crop that is failing. Someone should tell us when to put the brood now that the weather has changed.

title: Elephants eat the standing paddy every October and nobody comes before morning
body_original: Around Dhalbhumgarh the elephant herd comes from the Dalma side into our paddy every October-November when the grain is filling. In one night twenty families lose their year. Compensation comes after a year and is small. Forest department comes in the morning. We need a way to know the herd is coming that evening, and something that keeps them out that does not kill anyone.

title: Toilets were built but there is no water, so everyone has gone back to the fields
body_original: In Littipara block all houses got a toilet under the mission in 2019. There is no water within the tola from February to June so nobody uses them, everyone goes to the field again, and in the rains the whole tola gets loose motions. The toilets are now used to keep goats. Building was easy, water was not thought about. We need a toilet that works with the little water we have.

title: Coal transport dust from the new mine has covered every field between Barkagaon and the plant
body_original: Since the coal mine near Barkagaon started sending trucks, every field along the road is under black dust. Vegetables do not sell because they are black, and the mustard flower does not set. Old people have started breathing trouble. We want the dust measured properly by someone who is not the company, and to know which crops or trees can survive next to this road.

title: 2022 में स्वीकृत पीएमजीएसवाई सड़क आज तक नहीं बनी
body_original: कुंदा प्रखंड में हमारे गांव तक की सड़क प्रधानमंत्री ग्राम सड़क योजना में 2022 में स्वीकृत हुई थी, बोर्ड भी लगा था। ठेकेदार ने आधा किलोमीटर मिट्टी डालकर काम छोड़ दिया। बीडीओ साहब को तीन बार आवेदन दिया, कोई जवाब नहीं। हम चाहते हैं कि जो सड़क मंज़ूर है वह बने और जिस ठेकेदार ने पैसा लिया उससे पूछा जाए।

title: Jal Jeevan Mission taps were fitted in 2024 but not one day of water has come
body_original: In our village in Palojori block every house got a tap under Jal Jeevan Mission in early 2024. The pipes are laid, the tank is built, and not a single day has water come. The junior engineer does not pick up the phone. The contractor got his payment. This is not a research problem, someone simply has to switch it on and be answerable for it.

title: Five classes, one para-teacher: the school runs on roll call alone
body_original: मुरहू के हमारे गांव के सरकारी स्कूल में पहली से पांचवीं तक पांच कक्षाएं हैं और पढ़ाने वाला एक पारा शिक्षक। वह एक कमरे में बच्चों को बैठाकर दूसरे में पढ़ाता है, आधी छुट्टी के बाद बच्चे घर भाग जाते हैं। नामांकन रजिस्टर में नब्बे बच्चे हैं, पर तीसरी के बच्चे अपना नाम नहीं लिख पाते। हमें कोई ऐसा तरीका चाहिए जिससे एक शिक्षक पांच कक्षाओं को सच में पढ़ा सके — कोई समय-सारणी, कोई गतिविधि, कुछ ऐसा जो हमारे स्कूल में चले।

title: Girls stop studying after class 8 — the high school is seven kilometres away
body_original: काठीकुंड के हमारे गांव में मिडिल स्कूल तक लड़कियां पढ़ती हैं, पर हाई स्कूल सात किलोमीटर दूर है और जाने का कोई साधन नहीं। मां-बाप बेटियों को पैदल नहीं भेजते, तो आठवीं के बाद पढ़ाई छूट जाती है। हर साल पंद्रह-बीस लड़कियां घर बैठ जाती हैं। कोई बताए कि गांव में ही नौवीं-दसवीं की पढ़ाई कैसे हो — फोन पर, हफ्ते में दो दिन आने वाले शिक्षक से, या किसी और तरीके से जो हमारे यहां चले।

title: Children speak Santali at home and understand nothing in a Hindi classroom
body_original: In our Littipara village the children speak Santali at home and the school teaches only in Hindi. In class one and two they sit silent for a year and learn nothing; by class three half have stopped coming. The teachers are willing but they have no bridge material — no Santali primer, no Ol-Chiki charts, nothing that starts from the language the child already knows. We want to know what a first-year bridge course for our school would look like, and whether older students could be trained to teach it.

title: Power fails every study hour — children read by kerosene lamp
body_original: गारू के हमारे गांव में शाम छह बजे से रात दस बजे तक रोज़ बिजली चली जाती है — यही बच्चे के पढ़ने का समय है। बच्चे डिबरी और मोबाइल की रोशनी में पढ़ते हैं, आंखें खराब हो रही हैं। दिन में भी वोल्टेज इतना कम रहता है कि पंखा नहीं चलता। कोई नापकर बताए कि बिजली कब-कब जाती है और पढ़ने के समय रोशनी के लिए सोलर और ग्रिड का कौन-सा मेल हमारे गांव में चलेगा।

title: Feeder trips every evening and nobody has measured when or why
body_original: Our Bhandaria village is electrified on paper, but the feeder trips every evening and comes back near midnight. The study hours are dark, the flour mill runs at a loss, and nobody can say whether the fault is load, distance, or maintenance — there is no measurement at all. We want the trips logged properly for a season, and an honest answer on what a household solar kit plus the grid could reliably run: lights for study, a fan, and phone charging.
